minutes.summary: A short special meeting held remotely. The committee waived the second reading of the transportation policy after no public comments were received, with a third reading set for Wednesday. It then voted by roll call to enter executive session on security deployment, not returning to public session.

what_happened.line: The School Committee waived the second reading of transportation policy 3601 by roll call vote at a short remote special meeting.
A third reading of the transportation policy is set for the Wednesday meeting, to be read in full.
Public comment was invited on the policy and none was made.
The committee voted to enter executive session on security deployment and did not return to public session.

The security discussion took place in closed session, so no public record shows what was decided about it.
